newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cheung Kong sets to offer new flats.
newsitem.headline: Cheung Kong sets to offer new flats.

text.p: Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd is set to offer units in its 60-storey Manhattan Heights residential development in Western district on Hong Kong Island for sale, but details have not yet been decided.
"Manhattan Heights comprises 476 apartments with hotel services," said Kenneth Yuen, senior advertising manager of Cheung Kong, in a telephone interview on Tuesday.
"About 50 percent of them will be held by the company for investment purposes and the balance will be offered for sale," Yuen said. "But the timing and price of the sales have not been decided yet."
Manhattan Heights, the construction of which is expected to be completed by the end of 1999, will have 35,000 square feet club house. The flats will range from 610 to 950 square feet.
As the development is about five minutes travelling distance to the Central business district, it is targeting executives and expatriates, Yuen said.
